title: Similar | Aftershock Arrival Window Assembly
goal: Read heterogeneous earthquake waveform files together with event and station metadata, convert them into ObsPy Stream/Catalog/Inventory objects, align each usable station trace to its event origin, and write `/root/arrival_windows.csv` with one row per station-event pair describing absolute review-window bounds, sample rate, duration, and channel coverage for downstream arrival analysis.
skillBenefitRationale: This task is centered on the canonical ObsPy data workflow: reading waveform files, representing custom and standard metadata with Stream/Trace, Catalog, Inventory, and UTCDateTime objects, and using those objects to derive aligned review windows. The shipped skill is the only critical dependency.
